meta.name: Super Singer
meta.description:
Super Singer is a reality-based Indian singing competition in Tamil language that aired on STAR Vijay. The program seeks to discover the best singing talent in Tamil Nadu through a series of statewide auditions. The show is sponsored by the mobile service provider, Airtel. The show debuted in 2006 and has completed its three seasons,presently in fourth season. The winner of event gets a chance to sing a Tamil movie song.

The show usually airs on All Weekday nights in India and is telecast worldwide through partner broadcasting networks.

videos.title: The Journey Begins
videos.overview: Season 5 of Airtel Super singer kicks off with the Trichy zonal auditions. A few among the hundreds of people auditioning for the show talk about their journey and their passion for singing. Super singers from the previous seasons judge the candidates as host Bhavana entertains the crowd.

videos.overview: Host Bhavana and Priyanka start the day two auditions with judges T L Maharajan, Sasirekha, Pop Shalini and SPB Charan. The participants give their performances in One Minute to Impress challenge.

videos.title: A Firefighter's Dream to Sing
videos.overview: The next batch enters the auditions, ready to showcase their talent and follow their dreams. Mr. Ramesh, a firefighter by profession, auditions with a hope to fulfill his aspiration of becoming a professional singer. Let us see if he will move on to the next level.

videos.title: Irwin Victoria Shines
videos.overview: The auditions continue as hundreds of candidates go through the selection process, judged precisely by the playback singers. A few of the candidates stand out from the crowd, Irwin Victoria being one of them. He impresses the judges with his soulful singing and moves on to the next round.

videos.title: The Talented Mr. Ragavan
videos.overview: The next batch enter the auditions, ready to showcase their talent and follow their dreams. Mr. Ragavan, a middle aged candidate, auditions with the hopes of achieving what he couldn't in his younger days. Will he move on to the next level or will his journey come to an end?

videos.title: Auditions Galore

videos.overview: In today's episode, contestants Faridha, Bhargavi, Sowmya, Lakshmi Pradeep and Irwin Victoria compete among each other in the One-on-One round.

videos.title: Judges are Mesmerised
videos.overview: Contestants Aravind Mukundan, Janaki M Nair, Bikash Sunar, Sravani Kiran, Shibi, and Faridha mesmerise the judges with their soothing songs. Who will get into the safe zone?

videos.overview: This episode features contestants Anand Aravindakshan, Latha Krishna, Vidnesh, Nikitha, Sukesh and Rajaganapathy in the set intro round. Who will come out victorious?

videos.title: The First Competitive Round
videos.overview: The top 30 contestants are facing their first competitive round. Bhargavi, Nirujan, Sowmya, Arjun Adapalli, Hari and Devika from judge Unnikrishnan's team perform with the weakest performer facing elimination along with the weakest performers from the other teams.

videos.title: Tribute to MSV
videos.overview: This week has the contestants performing late maestro MSV's best songs in the Tribute to MSV round. Latha Krishna, Sowmya, Shibi, Anand Aravindakshan, Sreeraj and Raghavan give amazing performances as MSV's closest musicians and the judges share anecdotes about the music legend.

videos.title: The Tribute Continues
videos.overview: The tribute to MSV continues as Vignesh, Nirujan, Vaishak, Rajaganapathy and Aravind perform evergreen songs of the late legend. Contestants from previous seasons and MSV's own musicians perform and share their experiences with the legend, MSV.

videos.title: Singer L R Eswari on the Show
videos.overview: Singer L R Eswari graces the show as a special guest. She shares her memories of the legend MSV and performs a few of her favorite songs. Shivaali, Nikitha, Sukesh, Kirthana, Bhargavi and Govind sing beautifully as the Super Singer juniors perform a soulful medley as a special tribute performance.

videos.title: Vani Jayaram Talks about MSV
videos.overview: The episode starts off with an AV of A R Rahman reminiscing about the legend MSV. Special guest Vani Jayaram performs and shares her experiences of working with MSV as Kiran Shravan, Devika, Bikash, Priya Jerson and Siyad continue to give touching tributes to the maestro.

videos.overview: The Super Singer juniors and Super Singer stars give splendid special performances as a tribute to maestro MSV. Aravind K, Faridha, Irwin Victoria, Hari, Lakshmi and Arjun Adapalli render some hit songs of MSV, with the weakest performer of the week facing elimination.

videos.title: Western Round Begins
videos.overview: Following the MSV tribute week, the western round kicks off with Aravind, Latha Krishna, Shibi, Kiran Shravan, Anand Aravindakshan and Prasad Govind from judge Mano's team delivering stellar performances, motivated by the threat of the impending multiple eliminations by the end of the week.

videos.overview: Team Mano's Faridha, Bikash and Lakshmi give their performances. The weakest performer of the team is placed in the waiting zone with a chance of elimination. Raghavan, Vaisakh and Sherley from judge Srinivas' team perform amazingly as the western round blazes on.

videos.title: Battle for the Safe Zone
videos.overview: Special guests, actress Radha and Kalyan Master grace the show as Aravind K, Shivali, Kirthana, Irwin Victoria, Siyad and Priya Jerson from judge Srinivas' team rock the stage with stellar performances, each trying to outdo the other in this battle for the safe zone.

videos.title: Rajaganapathy is Amazing
videos.overview: The western round rolls on with Sreeraj completing Team Srinivas' performances. The weakest performer from the team is chosen. Team Unnikrishnan follows with performances by Hari, Devika, Sowmya, Nirujan and finally Rajaganapathy, who shines out with an amazing rendition of "Nangaai".

videos.title: Double Elimination
videos.overview: The western round finally reaches its climax with Vignesh, Arjun Adapalli, Bhargavi, Sukesh and Nikitha from Team Unnikrishnan performing. The weakest performers from the three teams are assembled and two of them face elimination. Who will leave the competition?

videos.title: Latest Hits Round
videos.overview: This week follows with the contestants performing the latest hit songs. In a boys vs. girls style challenge, Team Unnikrishnan starts the game with Sowmya, Vignesh, Arjun Adapalli,  Nikitha and Rajaganapathy performing foot-tapping numbers, making for a very lively show.

videos.title: Team Srinivas Performs
videos.overview: The latest hits round continues as Team Unnikrishnan's Hari, Nirujan, Devika and Bhargavi perform.The weakest contestant enters the danger zone, facing the possibility of elimination. Following Team Unnikrishnan, Vaisakh begins the score for Team Srinivas.

videos.title: Competition Heats Up
videos.overview: Aravind K kicks off the show with a breezy rendition of "Azhaipaaya" as Team Srinivas continues to perform in the latest hits round. Shivali, Priya Jerson, Ragavan, Irwin Victoria and Siyad sing their hearts out as the competition heats up.

videos.title: Enter Team Mano
videos.overview: Sherley and Sreeraj give the last performances for Team Srinivas, with the weakest performer moving into the danger zone. Finally, Team Mano steps up with Govind, Anand Aravindakshan and Faridha performing their renditions of latest hits.

videos.title: Facing Elimination
videos.overview: The latest hits round finally comes to an end with Lakshmi, Shibi, Kiran Sravan, Arvind and Latha Krishna from Team Mano performing. The weakest performers from all three teams are assembled and one faces elimination. Who will it be?

videos.title: Dance Attack Round
videos.overview: The top 26 contestants enter the dance attack round, with singer Usha Uthup entering as a new judge. Contestants Aravind K, Sherley, Siyad, Irwin Victoria and Priya Jerson perform foot-tapping numbers as the renditions live up to the round's name.

videos.title: Govind Rocks the Show
videos.overview: The dance attack round continues as Sreeraj, Raghavan, Vaisakh and Shivali from Team Srinivas perform with the weakest performer placed in the danger zone. Team Usha Uthup takes the mantle with Lakshmi and Govind rocking the stage with impressive performances.

videos.title: Anand Steals the Thunder
videos.overview: Anand Aravindakshan steals the show in today's dance attack round with a brilliant rendition of "Potu thaaku", making the crowd dance in merriment. He is followed by Shibi, Latha Krishna, Faridha and Arvind who give their best, aiming to impress the judges and make it to the safe zone.

videos.title: Team Usha Uthup Takes Charge
videos.overview: Kiran Shravan gives the last performance for Team Usha Uthup in the dance attack round and the weakest performer of the team is selected. Team Unnikrishnan follows with an amazing performance by Rajaganapathy. Sukesh Kuttan, Hari and Vignesh continue with some inspiring performances.

videos.title: The Top 25 are Chosen
videos.overview: The dance attack round reaches a climax with Bhargavi, Nikitha, Arjun Adapalli, Sowmya and Nirujan finishing the score for Team Unnikrishnan. The weakest performer from the three teams are chosen, with one of them facing elimination. Who will move on to the top 25 position?

videos.title: Hip Hop, Disco Special
videos.overview: Ma Pa Ka Anand and Bhavana kick-start today's Hip hop, remix and disco round. Arvind, Lakshmi, Kiran, Anand and Govind croon disco songs.

videos.title: Hip Hop Fun Round Continues
videos.overview: In today's round two of Hip hop and Disco, Faridha, Shibhi, Latha and Nirujan sing some popular songs. Later, actors from the show Sarvanan and Meenakshi take the center stage to sing and entertain the audience.

videos.title: More of Hip Hop
videos.overview: In today's show, Sowmya, Bhargavi, Arjun, Vignesh and Nikitha sing some popular numbers. Later, the actors from the serial Pudhu Kavithai take center stage and entertain everybody.

videos.title: Some Brilliant Performances
videos.overview: In today's episode, Hari, Siyad, Rajaganapathy and Sreeraj set the stage on fire with their brilliant performances. Later, the actors from the serial Kalyanam Mudhal Kaadal Vara entertain everybody.

videos.title: Who Will Be Eliminated?
videos.overview: Shivali, Irwin, Aravind, Vaisakh and Priya sing some popular Hip hop numbers. One of the contestants, who is in the danger zone, will get eliminated.

videos.title: It's Duet Time
videos.overview: Ma Pa Ka Ravi and Priyanka kick-start today's round of Duet with Super Singer Stars. The participants of Super Singer Four croon romantic duets with the Super Singer Five contestants. Aravind-Anu, Vaisakh-Srinisha, Siyad-Priyanka and Raghavan-Usha sing some romantic duets.

videos.title: Romantic Duets Continue
videos.overview: The Super Singer Duet round continues. The Super Singer Four participants join Super Singer Five contestants in singing duets. Irwin-Sayad, Sreeraj-Rakshitha, Priya-Kaushik and Govind-Pooja render some romantic songs.

videos.title: Duets Galore
videos.overview: The Super Singer Duet round continues. The Super Singer Four participants join Super Singer Five contestants in singing duets. Faridha-Satya, Lakshmi-Sai, Arvind-Malika, Latha-Nivas and Kiran-Arvind give extraordinary performances, thus impressing the judges.

videos.title: Duet with the Stars Round
videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show with Duet with SS Stars round. Anand Aravindakshan-SS Star Pooja, Rajaganapathy-SS Star Shravan, Nikitha-SS Star Sathyaprakash, Arjun Adapalli-SS Star Parvathy and Bhargavi-SS Star Sai Charan showcase their performances.

videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show with Duet with SS Stars round. Hari-SS Star Haripriya, Nirujan-SS Star Sreesha, Sowmya-SS Star Santhosh and Vignesh-SS Star Deepthi battle it out against each other. Vignesh, Raghavan and Kiran Shravan face elimination.

videos.title: Top 20 Selection – Trio Challenge
videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge between Judge Unni Krinshnan vs. Usha Uthup vs. Srinivas' team. The first trio challenge is between Hari, Faridha and Vaishak. In the second trio challenge, it is a clash between Govind, Erwin and Nirujan.

videos.title: Intense Trio Challenge
videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with the continuation of the Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge. Govind sums up the second trio challenge with his performance. Nikitha, Priya and Latha leave the judges awestruck with their performances in the third trio challenge round.

videos.title: The Judges Are Spellbound
videos.overview: Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge continues. Aravind, Sri Raj and Rajaganapathy's performance in the fourth trio challenge leaves the judges spellbound and each win their spot in the top 20 slot. Shivali, Bhargavi and Kiran battle it out against each other in the fifth trio challenge.

videos.title: Siyad Impresses All
videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with the continuation of the Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge. Kiran sums up the fifth trio challenge with her performance. Lakshmi, Siyad and Sowmya battle it out in the sixth trio challenge round. Siyad's performance leaves the judges overwhelmed.

videos.title: 90 Seconds To Impress
videos.overview: Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge continues. The last trio challenge round has Aravind, Anand Aravindakshan and Arjun battling against each other to secure a spot in the top 20. The six contestants in the danger zone are given 90 seconds to seal their spot in the five slots vacant in the top 20.

videos.title: Folk Round Special
videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start off the Folk round with contestants Shivali K Aroraa, Aravind Mukundan, Arjun Adapalli, Sreeraj K Sahajan, and Sowmya. The contestants battle it out against each other.

videos.title: Mesmerising Performances
videos.overview: In today's episode, contestants Aravind K, Govind Prasad, Lakshmi Pradeep, Priya Jerson and Nirujan compete among each other in the folk round. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

videos.title: The Celebration of Music
videos.overview: Contestants Faridha, Hari, Sravani Kiran, Siyad, and Irwin Victoria mesmerise the judges with their performances in the folk round. Who will get into the safe zone?

videos.title: Vaisakh and Shivali Bid Adieu
videos.overview: This episode features contestants Bhargavi, Anand Aravindakshan, Rajaganapathy, Vaisakh, and Latha Krishna in the folk round. Who will come out victorious?

videos.title: One-on-One Challenge
videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the One-on-One round with contestants Aravind Mukundan, Nirujan, Priya Jesron and Anand Aravindakshan. They battle it out against each other. Who will come out victorious?

videos.title: A Music Treat
videos.overview: In today's episode, contestants Faridha, Bhargavi, Sowmya, Lakshmi Pradeep and Irwin Victoria compete with each other in the One-on-One round. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

videos.title: One-on-One Challenge
videos.overview: The One-on-One challenge continues with Latha performing against Irwin. Rajaganapathy faces Siyad and Govind is opposite Aravind K in this tense competition, with the victorious one entering the safe zone and the weaker performers moving to the danger zone.

videos.title: Battle for the Safe Zone
videos.overview: Kiran Sravan faces Hari in the first One-on One challenge of the day, followed by two remaining contestants, Sreeraj and Arjun Adapalli battling it out for a spot in the safe zone.

videos.title: Threat of Facing Elimination
videos.overview: With the judges saving three of the seven danger zone contestants, the remaining four must fight each other in the Lifeline round to secure a spot in the safe zone. The singers give their best, motivated by the threat of elimination looming over their heads.

videos.title: Dedication Round
videos.overview: The dedication round starts with a performance by Aravind K who dedicates a song to his mother, thus moving everyone to tears. This is followed by equally touching performances by Lakshmi, Kiran Sravan and Hari. Host Bhavana surprises everyone with a special performance dedicated to her husband.

videos.title: Moving Dedications for Loved Ones
videos.overview: The touching dedication songs continue as Aravind, Sreeraj and Priya Jerson give soothing performances for their loved ones. Super Singer veteran, Jessica gives a special performance, with judge Srinivas rendering a beautiful composition penned by guest Madhan Karky, dedicated to music legend MSV.

videos.title: Uthara Unnikrishnan Performs
videos.overview: The dedication round continues with soulful performances by Bhargavi, Anand Aravindakshan and Arjun Adapalli. Super Singer Junior Anu relives her own dedication round and the events that occurred in the previous season. Judge Unnikrishnan's daughter, Uthara, delivers a beautiful special performance.

videos.title: Ma Ka Pa Anand Sings for Susan
videos.overview: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand dedicates a special song for his wife Susan, who sings a short but soulful number for her husband. Nirujan, Siyad and Faridha give touching performances, making everyone emotional. Judge Mano gives a special dedication performance for his wife and daughter.

videos.title: Irwin's Heartfelt Performance
videos.overview: The dedication round continues with scintillating performances from Rajaganapathy, Sowmya and Latha Krishna. Judge Usha Uthup gives a beautiful rendition of "Meri Maa" and gets the contestants to sing along. Irwin surprises everyone by singing for his parents and presenting them with a touching gift.

videos.title: Top 15 Lifeline Round
videos.overview: Phase 1 of the top 15 selections gets underway with lifeline performances by the bottom five contestants from last week: Aravind, Kiran Shravan, Hari, Sreeraj and Bhargavi. The two weakest performers face each other in a tie-breaker round while the loser faces immediate elimination.

videos.title: Stephen Devassy Returns
videos.overview: Stephen Devassy returns to perform with a world class orchestra, guaranteeing a musical treat. Phase 2 of the top 15 selections kicks off with performances by Latha Krishna, Rajaganapathy, Sowmya and Lakshmi. The singer with the least marks enters the danger zone and will possibly face elimination.

videos.title: Magical Performances
videos.overview: Day 2 of the top 15 selections, phase 2 sets the ball rolling with brilliant performances by Nirujan, Priya Jerson, Aravind K and Anand Aravindakshan. Stephen Devassy and the orchestra enthrall the crowd with their magical scores. The contestant with the least marks enters the danger zone.

videos.title: Judge Usha Uthup Performs
videos.overview: The top 15 selections continue as Aravind, Sreeraj, Faridha and Irwin Victoria fight it out to evade the danger zone and move on to the next round. As an added bonus, the contestants perform improvised renditions with Stephen and the brass band orchestra, with Judge Usha Uthup joining in.

videos.title: Voting against Elimination
videos.overview: Hari, Kiran Shravan, Siyad and Arjun Adapalli battle it out to secure a spot in the top 15. The four weakest performers from phase 2 are made to go through an audience and musician voting, with three making it to the safe zone. The weakest contender faces elimination.

videos.title: The Battle of the Best
videos.overview: The top 15 singers start the show with three judges pitting their best singers against each other. The round is an Imman song special with music director Imman being the special guest. Lakshmi, Sowmya and Sreeraj sing in the first round with the next batch featuring Arjun Adapalli, Anand and Siyad.

videos.title: A Grandfather's Love
videos.overview: The Imman special round continues as Siyad performs. Challenge 4 has Aravind K, Latha Krishnan and Hari singing, with the next round featuring Nirujan, Kiran Shravan and Priya Jerson. Nirujan delivers a splendid performance followed by a touching AV of him visiting his grandfather in Colombo.

videos.title: Trio Challenge Gets Tough
videos.overview: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with the fourth trio challenge between Kiran vs. Priya vs. Nirujan on Imman's composition as the theme for the round. In the fifth trio challenge, Irwin battles it out with Faridha and Rajaganapathy.

videos.title: 21st Century Songs Round
videos.overview: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with lifeline performances for the nine contestants to secure their position in the top 14. Anand Aravindakshan, Arjun Adapalli, Aravind and Lakshmi Pradeep battle it out against each other in 21st century songs round.

videos.title: Hit Songs of 2015
videos.overview: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the 21st century songs round with Ananth Vaidyanathan. Contestants Irwin Victoria, Sreeraj K Sahajan, J Nirujan, Latha Krishna and Priya Jerson battle it out with each other. Watch out for some amazing performances.

videos.title: Sujatha, Deva on the Show
videos.overview: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana welcome singers Sujatha and Deva to the show. Contestants Kiran Sravan, J Nirujan, Arjun Adaplli, Sowmya, and Lakshmi Pradeep compete amongst each other.

videos.title: The Top 13 Finalists
